definitions.gloss: on the platform; on stage; at the podium
definitions.explanation: The raised platform or stage area where someone stands to give a speech, receive an award, or perform at a ceremony or event.

examples.japanese: {壇上|だんじょう}に{上|あ}がって{挨拶|あいさつ}した。
examples.english: I went up on stage and gave a greeting.

examples.japanese: {壇上|だんじょう}の{演者|えんじゃ}に{拍手|はくしゅ}が{送|おく}られた。
examples.english: Applause was given to the performer on stage.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}で{壇上|だんじょう}に{立|た}ち、{代表|だいひょう}として{答辞|とうじ}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I stood on the stage at the graduation ceremony and read the farewell address as the class representative.

notes:
Refers to the raised platform or stage area where someone stands to give a speech, receive an award, or perform. Combines {壇|だん} (platform, podium) and {上|じょう} (on top of).

USAGE:
- Commonly used with positional expressions: {壇上|だんじょう}に{上|あ}がる (to go up on stage), {壇上|だんじょう}に{立|た}つ (to stand on stage)
- Used in contexts like ceremonies, speeches, presentations, and award events
- Can also be used as a location modifier: {壇上|だんじょう}の{人|ひと} (the person on stage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壇上|だんじょう}に{上|あ}がる: to go up on stage
- {壇上|だんじょう}に{立|た}つ: to stand on the platform
- {壇上|だんじょう}から{降|お}りる: to come down from the stage
- {壇上|だんじょう}で{挨拶|あいさつ}する: to give a greeting on stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ステージ: stage — the loanword, broader in use (concerts, events)
- {舞台|ぶたい}: stage — used for theater and performances, also figuratively
- {演壇|えんだん}: speaker's platform, podium — specifically for giving speeches
- {登壇|とうだん}: going up to the podium — the act of ascending the stage
